evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.040 Torr at the start of growth with Ar near 100 sccm.
Pressure rose progressively to 3.232 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Pressure reached 3.329 Torr while Ar was 100.0 sccm and temperature was 750.0 C, both at setpoint; sustained pressure drift is not explained by these readings.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null O2 readings cannot verify the growth atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: Independent atmosphere/O2 measurement is required to verify growth conditions; pressure-control expectations and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
